title: IGY listening posts for U-2 overflights

tellings.quote: That gave Townshend an opportunity to travel around and set up these, what we would call listening post, for the U-2s as they overflew Soviet Russia.

plain: In 1957, during the International Geophysical Year, a worldwide scientific programme, the physicist and inventor Townsend Brown travelled around setting up what amounted to listening posts to support the American U-2 spy planes flying over the Soviet Union. The researcher Jan Lundquist tells this in a documentary on Michels' show about Brown, without naming a source; it would mean the scientific programme served as cover for spying.
